text.body:
nijjariya-jarā-maraṇaṁ vandittā jiṇa-varaṁ mahāvīraṁ
chappaṇṇaya-gāhāo vocchaṁ suyaṇassa joggāo // Chapp.1
purisesacca-samiddhe, aliya-daliddesahāve-santuṭṭhe
tava-niyama-dhamma-maïevisamā visamā honti // Chapp.2
gayaṇammi gahā sayaṇammisumiṇayāsaüṇayā vaṇaggesu
taha vāharanti purisaṁ jaha diṭṭhaṁ puvva-kammehiṁ // Chapp.3
savve tāha pasatthāsumiṇā saüṇāgahā ya nakkhattā
ti-huyaṇa-maṅgala-nilayaṁ hiyaeṇa jiṇaṁ vahantassa // Chapp.4
katthaï na karaïmollaṁ suvaṇṇayaṁ kattha dūhavo vando
katthaïsarala-sahāvo jaṇona saṁmāṇaṇaṁ lahaï // Chapp.5
dūra-ttho ḍahaï ravī, aggī aṅgehĩpharasioḍahaï
ḍahaï piya-vippaogo, suyaṇovi a-daṁsaṇe ḍahaï // Chapp.6
ḍahae suyaṇa-viogo,ḍahaïa-ṇāhattaṇaṁ para-viese
ḍahaïya abbhakkhāṇaṁ,ḍahaïa-kajjaṁkayaṁpacchā // Chapp.7
santa-guṇa-vippaṇāse asanta-dosubbhaveyajaṁ dukkhaṁ
taṁ sosei samuddaṁ; kiṁ puṇa hiyayaṁ maṇussāṇaṁ? // Chapp.8
santehi a-santehiyaparassa kiṁ jampiyehi dosehiṁ?
attho jaso na labbhaï, soyaa-mitto kao hoi // Chapp.9
mahureṇa jiṇaha kaḍuyaṁ, khamāĕ dappaṁ guruṁ paṇāmeṇa
santoseṇa yalohaṁ, kalahaṁ ca ajampiyavveṇa // Chapp.10
ekka-sukaeṇa tūsaha jāva sayaṁ dukkiyāṇa volei
sa-sarīre vi na sakkā diyahe diyahe piyaṁ kāuṁ // Chapp.11
kaha nāma tassa pāvaṁ cintijjaïāgae vikohammi
uppala-dala-sukumālo jassa ghareŏlliohattho? // Chapp.12
piya-pāhuṇa-āgamaṇea-pahuppantassasajjaṇa-jaṇassa
maraṇāoabbhahiyaṁuppajjaïmāṇasaṁdukkhaṁ // Chapp.13
na hu aï-bhariyaṁdhammaï; jaha bhariyaṁ taha suhāvahaṁ hoi;
pancammi na yakilimmaïgao vi piya-pāhuṇo hoi. // Chapp.14
te dhannā je dhammaṁ suṭṭhu vi jāṇanti suṭṭhu vikaranti
jīviya-sāram a-sāraṁ:khaṇeṇa pariyattae savvaṁ // Chapp.15
sā māyā so ya piyā, taṁ mittaṁbandhavo yaso ceva
jo hiya-nissesa-karaṁ dhammassa pahe nayaṁ dei // Chapp.16
na vi taṁ karei māyā piyā ya putto ya bandhava-jaṇo ya
jaṁ purisassāyariyā karanti dhammaṁ uvaïsantā. // Chapp.17
kiṁ acchaha vīsatthā? diyahā volenti turiya-pahiya vva;
te ya na gaṇanti tubbhe, tubbhehi na vi ya gaṇijjanti. // Chapp.18
tuṭṭhā honti maṇussā: Indamaho āgao tti ramaṇīo;
na vi jāṇanti varāyā: paḍiyā saṁvacchara-salāyā! // Chapp.19
uccāsaṇo mah-iccho, āṇāinto ya nir-uvayārīo
alaso piya-jimmaṇa rūsaṇo ya na ciraṁ pio hoi. // Chapp.20
sahasatti pīimantā a-tthakke jaṁ va taṁ va jampantā
pāse ya nivesantāpiyā yasattuttaṇam uventi. // Chapp.21
nīyaṁ aïkkamanto puvvābhāsī piyāĩ jampanto
chandaṁ aṇuyattanto veso vi jaṇo piyo hoi. // Chapp.22
chandaṁ jo aṇuyattaï mammaṁ rohaï guṇā payāsei
na hu navari māṇusāṇa ya, devāṇa vi dullaho hoi. // Chapp.23
āvaṁ ti ya evaṁ ti ya vottavvaṁ paṇḍieṇa puriseṇa:
iyaro vi hoi tuṭṭho, iyaraṁ pi (ya) tattiyaṁ ceva. // Chapp.24
chajjaï pahussa laliyaṁ, piyāĕ māṇaṁ, khamā samatthassa
jāṇantassa ya bhaṇiyaṁ, moṇaṁ ca a-yāṇamāṇassa. // Chapp.25
sahaï na kaḍuyaṁ jampaï, dose na lahaï guṇā payāsei
rūsantāṇa na rūsaï, dakkhiṇṇa-mahābhaḍo suyaṇo. // Chapp.26
suyaṇo na ceva rūsaï: aha rūsaï mangulaṁ na cintei:
aha cintei na jampaï; aha jampaï lajjio hoi. // Chapp.27
jaṁ dujjaṇassa suyaṇo lajjāe sahaï chinna-lajjassa
taṁ jāṇaï nillajjo, eso a-samatthao sahaï. // Chapp.28
aṇuyattiyaṁ na yāṇaï, piye vi bhaṇie vi a-ppiyaṁ bhaṇaï,
dāṇeṇa na sampajjaï; natthi uvāo khala-yaṇassa. // Chapp.29
bajjhaï mantehi visaṁ, hatthi rajjūhi seuṇā salilaṁ;
payaï-visamassa bandho na yāṇimo dujjaṇa-jaṇassa. // Chapp.30
savvassa esa payaī: piyammi uppāie piyaṁ kāuṁ:
suyaṇassa kā vi payaī: a-kae vi pie piyaṁ kāuṁ. // Chapp.31
kajjammi samāvaḍie aṇuyattaha dujjaṇaṁ payatteṇa
visam āsā kira jāyaï amayāŏ visaṁ na saṁbhavaï. // Chapp.32
jaï vi khamā paribhūyā, jaï vi khamantassa āyaro natthi
taha vi khamā khamiyavvā; khama-sariso bandhavo natthi. // Chapp.33
kaha tassa rūsiyavvaṁ jassa paṇāmo puṇo vi kāyavvo?
accanta-nigguṇassa vi kaha sakkā rūsiuṁ tassa? // Chapp.34
rosassa khamā daṇḍo, kāma-guṇāṇaṁ nirumbhaṇā daṇḍo;
dujjaṇa-jaṇassa kalah-ujjayassa parivajjaṇā daṇḍo. // Chapp.35
bhaddaṁ pahū suyāṇaṁ avarāheūṇa baddha-vaïrāṇa
paṇivaïya-vacchalāṇaṁ muhutta-caṇḍ-ĕkka-rosāṇaṁ. // Chapp.36
bīheyavvaṁ dujjaṇa-jaṇassa niccaṁ paloṭṭa-jīhassa
vara-rayaṇa-nijjharassa va vayaṇa-karālaṁ vahantassa. // Chapp.37
atthakkŏ jampae payaï-pāyaḍaṁ savva-loya-tattillaṁ;
taṁ māṇusa-veyālaṁ puhaī vi sa-sankiyā bhamaï. // Chapp.38
nīo khaṇeṇa raccaï; ratto santo viraccaï khaṇeṇa,
nīo viratta-metto bhāmei gharā-ghariṁ dose. // Chapp.39
suyaṇo cirassa raccaï; ratto santo viraccaï cirassa;
suyaṇo jaï vi viraccaï; taha vi na dose payāsei. // Chapp.40
chullucchalei jaṁ hoi ūṇayaṁ rittayaṁ kaṇayaṇei;
bhariyāī na vuccanti supurisa-viṇṇāṇa-bhaṇḍāīṁ. // Chapp.41
taṁ khāha jaṁ jarijjaï, taṁ jampaha jaṁ mahā-yaṇe joggaṁ;
taṁ jampanti su-purisā, kāleṇa vi jaṁ na langhei. // Chapp.42
tattiya-mettaṁ jampahajettiya-mettassa nikkalaṁ cavaha
taṁukkhivehabhāraṁ jaṁ addha-pahe na chaḍḍeha. // Chapp.43
vujjhanti nāma bhārā, te cciya vujjhanti vīsamantehiṁ
sīla-bharo voḍhavvo jāvaj-jīvaṁa-vīsāmo. // Chapp.44
jo sakkayaṁ na yāṇaï suvisuddha-pāiyaṁ pi vottuṁ-je
moṇaṁtutassa saraṇaṁ, nīsaraṇaṁ ahava parisāe. // Chapp.45
uccaṁ na sikkhio addha-sikkhio sikkhio ku-sālāe
jo vahaï viusa-vāyaṁ so sariso sanniyāeṇa. // Chapp.46
ko kuvalayāṇa gandhaṁ karei mahurattaṇaṁ ca ucchūṇaṁ
vara-hatthīṇa ya līlaṁ, viṇayaṁ ca kula-ppasūyāṇaṁ? // Chapp.47
aṇuyattaha bhaṇaha piyaṁ, jaṁ kajjaṁ taṁmuṇehahiyaeṇa:
mahuraṁ lavaï mayūro sa-visaṁ ca bhuyangamaṁ gilaï. // Chapp.48
ucchū mahuro somo cando (taha) candaṇaṁ ciya su-surabhiṁ
abhijāo ya kulīṇo; ko doso āyaro c'eva? // Chapp.49
jo guḍa-kayāĕ vāyāĕ jampae visa-kaeṇa hiyaeṇa
so bila-gao va sappo vajjeyavvo payatteṇa // Chapp.50
a-ddiṭṭhe vi khala-yaṇe nāma-ggahaṇe vi hoi āsankā
aliya-palatte vi ahī ahi tti bhaṇa ko na bīhei? // Chapp.51
saṇḍeva-paḍiya-paccuṭṭhieṇa sīeṇa tharaharanteṇa
thereṇa pahe runnaṁ tāruṇṇaṁ sambharanteṇaṁ. // Chapp.52
vivarīyā thera-maī vārijjantī ya jāi thera-maī
kālo tettiya-thāmaṁ na pecchase paṇḍuraṁ sīsaṁ. // Chapp.53
taṁ hi sarīraṁ taṁ ji muhu, tāī ji lōyaṇayāĩ
nāi vihī sīsaṁ caraï, dinnau pāu jarāĕ. // Chapp.54
taĩ pahu dhaṇiya ghareṇa gharu nayaṇihĩ dāiya sō hu;
ēvahi jara-nīhōḍiyau, paḍijiya acchaï ēhu. // Chapp.55
laṭṭhī-dhariya-kaḍevara gaya-jovaṇa evam eva santuṭṭha;
sahaï kaḍuyaṁ pi bhaṇio: gao tumaṁ rūsiuṁ kālo! // Chapp.56
siru paliyaũ muhũ vali-bhariu; jara laggī haya nāma
maraṇaṁ hōi acintiyaũ; dhammu karahi jiya nāma. // Chapp.57
caya mahilaṁ muha-kaḍuyaṁ, caya mittaṁ natthi jattha sab-bhāvaṁ
caya sāmiyaṁ a-dāyaṁ, cayāhi paribhūyā vāsaṁ ca. // Chapp.58
ālattaṁ ciya rūsaï, bhiuḍiṁ kāūṇa dei ullāvaṁ
mahilā-chaleṇa purisaṁ bāhei purāṇayaṁ kammaṁ. // Chapp.59
mahilāṇa esa payaī: savvassa karenti vemaṇassāiṁ;
tassa na karenti navaraṁ jassa alaṁ kāmayanteṇaṁ. // Chapp.60
piya-jaṇa-apatta-bhogā bālattaṇayammi gahiya-sāmaṇṇā
a-ddiṭṭha-piya-viogā jiyanti muṇiṇo suhaṁ loe. // Chapp.61
su-labho vimāṇa-vāso, ega-cchattā ya meiṇī su-labhā;
logammi navari du-lahā pāyā jiṇa-vaddhamāṇassa. // Chapp.62
ucchū sahāva-mahuro, nimbo kaḍuo huyāsaṇo ḍahaṇo
suyaṇassa dujjaṇassa ya payaï-viseso sahāveṇa. // Chapp.63
jaṁ uppalassa patteṇa chijjae kiṁ va sattha-maggeṇaṁ?
mahurammi bhāṇiyavve, kiṁ te kaḍueṇa bhaṇieṇa? // Chapp.64
mahura-vayaṇehĩ āsāsiellayā je gayā para-viesaṁ
te tāĩ sambharantā, annattha raïṁ na bandhanti. // Chapp.65
kaḍuya-vayaṇehĩ nibbhacchiyallayā chinna-pema-sambandhā
te tāĩ sambharantā, tatto yapareṇavaccanti. // Chapp.66
dhannāṇa hiyaṁ ca miyaṁ ca gāhayaṁ desa-kāla-bhaṇiyaṁ ca
na ya para-loya-viruddhaṁ guṇa-pattaṭṭhaṁ bhaṇaï jīhā. // Chapp.67
esā satti-pahāre ya kasa-pahāre ya bala-pahāre ya
ucchahaï davāveuṁ du-viṇīyā attaṇo jīhā. // Chapp.68
jo dujjaṇeṇa mettī karei suyaṇo tti nāma kaliūṇa
suviṇaya-laddho va nihī pacchā icchaṁ na pūrei. // Chapp.69
dujjaṇa-saṁsaggīe āvāe ucchu-khaṇḍa-mahurāe;
visam iva aṇāya-giliyaṁpacchā hoī a-patthāo. // Chapp.70
jaï kancaṇaṁ girīo jāyaï (jaï) (mottiyaṁ) ca hattīo
viṇao ya kulīṇāo, ko doso āyaro ceva? // Chapp.71
paḍivayaṇa-samattheṇaṁ sahiyavvaṁ dujjaṇassa suyaṇaeṇa:
na ya paṭṭhimmi nilīṇo vasahassa siriṁ haraï kāo. // Chapp.72
ekko khamāĕ doso savvālankāra-bhūsiya-guṇāe
a-samattho tti gaṇijjaï jaṁ puriso dujjaṇa-jaṇeṇa. // Chapp.73
tisu je a-diṭṭha-puvvā rāya-kule guru-kule ya vesāsu
viṇṇāṇa-māṇa-laḍahattaṇāṇa te bāhirā honti. // Chapp.74
nāūṇa ya viṇṇāṇaṁ kāūṇa ya samara-sāhasaṁ kammaṁ
langheūṇa ya Meruṁ puṇṇehĩ viṇā suhaṁ katto? // Chapp.75
kāle uvaṇijjantī thevā vi mahosahī jiyāvei:
amaya-rasa-mīsieṇa vi mayassa kiṁ lāvaya-raseṇa? // Chapp.76
nhāyassa ya dhovattī jimiyassa ya jaṁ ca taṁ ca tambolaṁ
avasara-paḍhiyā gāhā, tinni vi saggaṁ visesanti. // Chapp.77
nīyaṁ ca laddha-pasaraṁ sippi-pauttaṁ ca attha-saṁjuttaṁ
mahilāyattaṁ ca gharaṁ, tinni vi sūlaṁ visesanti. // Chapp.78
thakke bhaṇiyaṁ sohaï, thakke bhaṇiyaṁ suhāvahaṁ hoi;
a-tthakke puṇa bhaṇiyaṁ kayaṁ pi kajjaṁ viṇāsei. // Chapp.79
kiṁ tammeha palāyaha jaṁ saraṇaṁ natthi ti-huyaṇe sayale
mottuṁ jiṇenda-vayaṇaṁ, sesaṁ savvaṁ kalayalei. // Chapp.80
suyaṇo sarala-sahāvo maïlijjanto vi dujjaṇa-jaṇeṇa
chāreṇa dappaṇo vviya ahiyayaraṁ nimmalo hoi. // Chapp.81
suyaṇassa dujjaṇārūsiyassa kaḍuyāĩ bhannamāṇassa
kamala-maule vva bhamaro bāhira-hiṇḍī bhamaï roso. // Chapp.82
jaha jaha aṇuyattijjaï taha taha nīyattaṇassa doseṇa
vaṭṭā-dhūlō va khalo caḍaï sire natthi sandeho. // Chapp.83
jeṇa viṇā na jivijjaï aṇuṇijjaï so kayāvarāho vi:
patte ya nagara-dāhe bhaṇa kassa na vallaho aggī? // Chapp.84
taṁ jampanti su-purisā taṁ ciya pamuhe karenti paḍivattī
rayaṇāyaro vva velaṁ kāleṇa vi jaṁ na langhei. // Chapp.85
para-tatti-taggaya-maṇo du-ssīlo aliya-jampao cavalo
jattha na dīsaï loo vaṇaṁ pi taṁ c'eva ramaṇīyaṁ. // Chapp.86
jo jassa niya-sahāvo sajjaṇa-saṁge vi so tahā ceva
bāṇo dhamme vi ṭhio guṇa-gahio taha vi mārei. // Chapp.87
khala-saṁge pariharie, pecchaha tilleṇa jaṁ phalaṁ pattaṁ:
mayaṇāhi-surabhi-gandhaṁ pahu-sīsaṁ pāviyaṁ jeṇa. // Chapp.88
jehiṁ ciya ubbhaviyā jāṇa pasāeṇa vaḍḍhiya-payāvā
samarā ḍahanti viṁjhaṁ: khalāṇa saṁgo cciya viṇāso. // Chapp.89
suyaṇāṇa neurāṇa ya suvvanto sui-maṇoraho saddo
so c'eva kaṇṇa-kaḍuo niyalāṇaṁ daḍḍha-pisuṇāṇaṁ. // Chapp.90
nāgehĩ vaṇaṁ kāgehĩ uvavaṇaṁ rāulaṁ pisuṇaehiṁ
ruddhaṁ mayarehĩ jalaṁ: haya-vihi suyaṇo kahiṁ jāu. // Chapp.91
taṁ natthi narenda-gharaṁ sayale mahi-maṇḍale bhamantāṇaṁ
jattha a-kāraṇa-kuviyā do tiṇṇi khalā na dīsanti. // Chapp.92
accanta-nimmalāṇa vi molla-mahagghāṇa sāra-garuyāṇaṁ
maṇiyārŏ vva khala-yaṇo rayaṇāṇa vi kuṇaï chiḍḍāiṁ. // Chapp.93
jāsiṁ c'eva naīṇaṁ vasahā ghuṇṭanti pāṇiyaṁ tisiyā
tāsiṁ c'eva naīṇaṁ siṁgehiṁ taḍī viṇāsenti. // Chapp.94
sarise māṇusa-jamme, ḍahaï khalo saj-jaṇo suhāvei:
lohaṁ ciya sannāho rakkhaï jīyaṁ asī haraï. // Chapp.95
jonhā-jaleṇa cando dhuvaï kalaṁkaṁ disā-vahu-muhāṇa
na ya dhuvaï niya-kalaṁkaṁ; savvo mujjhaï sa-kajjesu. // Chapp.96
jo jassa vaṭṭaĕ hiyaĕ so taṁ ṭhāvei sundara-sahāvaṁ:
vagghī-chāvaṁ jaṇaṇī bhaddaṁ somaṁ ca mannei. // Chapp.97
ratto duṭṭho mūḍho puvviṁ ku-ggāhio ya cattāri
uvaesassa aṇarihā; ariho puṇa hoi majjha-ttho. // Chapp.98
savvo parassa pecchaï vāl'-aggāo taṇūṇi chiḍḍāṇi;
niyaya-kayāĩ na pecchaï Himagirī-sihara-ppamāṇāiṁ. // Chapp.99
rattā pecchanti guṇā, dosā pecchanti je virajjanti;
majjha-tthā puṇa purisā dosā vi guṇā vi pecchanti. // Chapp.100
kariṇo kari-sanghaṭṭe, patthara-niyare suvaṇṇa-reha vva
nivvaḍaï vasaṇa-kasavaṭṭayammi sāro kulīṇāṇaṁ. // Chapp.101
sabbhāva-nehamaïe ratte raccijaï tti juttam iṇaṁ
aṇa-hiyae puṇa hiyayaṁ jaṁ dijjaï taṁ jaṇo hasaï. // Chapp.102
hīranti je guṇehiṁ vavagaya-nehā vi je na najjanti
runnaṁ pi jesu agghaï te putta kalimmi atthamiyā. // Chapp.103
visama-sahāvammi jaṇe na yāṇimo kaha guṇā viḍhappanti
hima-sīyale vi kiraṇe necchaï naliṇī miyankassa. // Chapp.104
sohiya-saṁvavahāro sab-bhāvo garuyayā khamā tucchā
vihaḍanti bandhavāṇa ya kali-kāla-payāva-doseṇa. // Chapp.105
kaṇhassa kālio phaṇa-maṇimmi siṭṭho A Ā A Ā Ā Ā
deh'-uppannā vi visaṁ cayanti deve parāhutte. // Chapp.106
ko va na dukkhaṁ patto? suhaṁ va bhaṇa kassa sāsayaṁ atthi?
kassa nirantara-paṇao? sohaggaṁ kassa a-kkhaliyaṁ? // Chapp.107
savvo puvva-kayāṇaṁ kammāṇaṁ pāvae phala-vivāgaṁ;
avarāhesu guṇesu ya nimitta-mettaṁ paro hoi. // Chapp.108
nau vi karantaha su-purisaha, jaï daïvaha na suhāi
kā vi avattha sa sampaḍaï jā cintaṇaha na jāi. // Chapp.109
annaha paricintijjaï saharisa-kaṇḍ'-ujjueṇa hiyaeṇa;
pariṇamaï annaha cciya kajjārambho vihi-vaseṇa. // Chapp.110
vihiṇā vi naḍijjanto savvo cciya bhaṇaï aṭṭhamo cando;
candassa Rāhu-gahaṇe, taïyā ko aṭṭhamo āsi? // Chapp.111
viupu naha-yalu rahavarāruḍhu
du-ppecchā tasu kiraṇa
attha-siharu duggamu suṇijjaï,
vihi-vihiyaṁ thū pariṇamaï
tēṇa sūru rāhĩ gilijjaï. // Chapp.112
bhuvaṇapphālu vi dhaṇu samaï,
vabbula-heṭṭhi ṭṭhiō
ōhu pekkhu na kiṁ gilantaïṁ
dēvāha vi ēha dasa
vihi karantu kiṁ kiṁ pilijjaï? // Chapp.113
dhannu suvaṇṇaũ ti-huyaṇahu, dinnau hōi hareṇa
tassa vi thū vihi-vihiu dhaṇu; saṅkaru naggaï teṇa. // Chapp.114
jā taï-lukkaha nāha kira sampaï phēḍaï dēi;
taha vi jarāau Haraha dhaṇu; gali haḍḍaĩ parihēi. // Chapp.115
annē bhaṇanti Jaṇaddaṇa Haraha tiijjau bhāu
tassa vi daïviṁ nimmiyau sayaṇiu kālau kāu. // Chapp.116
vihi-vihiyaṁ ciya labbhaï, amayaṁ devāṇa Mahumahe Lacchī
rayaṇāyare vi mahie, Harassa bhāe visaṁ jāyaṁ. // Chapp.117
puttaya vihi-vasi vinaḍiyaï, ko ti-ṇayaṇi sāhāru?
jiṁ Hara-vasahu vi tiṇa caraï, Vāsugi pavaṇāhāru. // Chapp.118
jaï vi ti-ṇayaṇu ekku puhaïhiṁ
vandijjaï sura-gaṇihiṁ
tō vi tāsi vaḍha kiha ṇamijjaï?
saraṇāgau jāsu sira A
sirahu lēvi Rāhiṁ gilijjaï. // Chapp.119
majjhe jaḍāṇa nivasantayassa katto guṇāṇa vitthāro?
Hara-sasiṇo taṁ bahuyaṁ sā vi kalā jaṁ na se jhīṇā. // Chapp.120
thevehi vi hoi guṇehĩ gāravaṁ ni-gguṇāṇa majjhammi
bhaṇṇanti jeṇa maṇuyā, sarehĩ kūyā vi kūya-sarā. // Chapp.121
jaha mūsagassa ekkeṇa vīhiṇā do vi vāvaḍā hatthā
taha a-muṇia-kallāṇā theveṇa vi uttuṇā honti // Chapp.122
guṇavantayāṇa jāṇaha honti guṇā pāyaḍā mah'-agghāyā
maṇi-rayaṇaṁ ciya goṭṭhe govā takkeṇa magganti. // Chapp.123
a-bhaṇantāṇa vi najjaï viṇṇāṇaṁ su-purisāṇa cariehiṁ
kiṁ bollanti maṇīo, jāŏ sahassehĩ gheppanti? // Chapp.124
aṭṭhattaṇāĩ Ā Ā A Ā jah'-icchāĕ ni-gguṇāṇaṁ pi
sajjaṇa-salāhaṇijjā sokkhehĩ guṇā viḍhappanti. // Chapp.125
puvva-kaya-asuha-kammo puriso a-suhassa uvviyanto vi
nivaḍaï a-suha-kkhalio kali-kalaha-kilesa-jālammi. // Chapp.126
jāṇaï su-y-andhayāre vi vacchao māyaraṁ gavesanto
daïyaṁ ca muṇaï hiyayaṁ, vesaṁ jāṇanti nayaṇāĩ. // Chapp.127
jassa na vaṇṇei jaṇo sajjaṇa-goṭṭhīsu guṇa-sahassāiṁ
kiṁ tassa jaṇaṇi-jovvaṇa-viuḍaṇa-metteṇa jammeṇaṁ? // Chapp.128
mā dosu cciya geṇhaha; virale ya guṇe pasaṁsaha jaṇassa:
akkha-pauro vi uyahī bhaṇṇaï rayaṇāyaro loke. // Chapp.129
savvo guṇesu rajjaï; guṇa-rahiyaṁ ko jaṇaṁ sammalliyaï?
kusumaṁ pi gandha-rahiyaṁ pattiya bhamarā na sevanti. // Chapp.130
guṇa-jāla-baddha-mūle sacca-phale neya-pallava-saṇāhe
nehamaïyammi suyaṇe, mitta-dume ko na vīsamaï? // Chapp.131
sa-bbhāviyaṁ siṇehaṁ sama-dukkha-sahejjayaṁ su-sīlaṁ ca
dūrāloya-vihasiyaṁ ko mitta-suhaṁ na sambharaï? // Chapp.132
gujjhassa saṁnihāṇaṁ, suhassa dukhassa kahaṇa-vīsamaṇaṁ,
ekkaṁ pi jassa mittaṁ natthi hu kiṁ tassa jīeṇaṁ? // Chapp.133
taṁ mittaṁ kāyavvaṁ jaṁ mittaṁ vasaṇa-desa-yālammi
ālihiya-bhitti-vāullayaṁ va na parammuhaṁ ṭhāi. // Chapp.134
baddha-siṇeho aïyāra-vallaho appa-kajja-maï-kusalo
vajjasu kao vi mitto eyāvattho tumaṁ su-yaṇu. // Chapp.135
majjha-ttheṇa vi sasiṇā cakkāṇa na tīrae piyaṁ kāuṁ;
vihaḍaṇa-sanghaḍaṇaṁ ciya, puṇo vi mitto cciya karei. // Chapp.136
jaha sa-rase taha sukkhe vi pāyave vahaï aṇudiṇaṁ viṁjho:
ucchanga-vaḍḍhiyaṁ nigguṇaṁ pi garuyā na siḍhilanti. // Chapp.137
uttama-jaṇa-saṁsaggī kāyavvā jaï vi ni-pphalā hoi.
merussa kaḍaĕ laggaṁ taṇaṁ pi taṁ kancaṇaṁ hoi. // Chapp.138
ēha na cinta mahā-dumaha jiva mahu mūlu palīṇu
nisi andhārī vappuḍā sauṇā kattha nilīṇā. // Chapp.139
jonhā-jaleṇa bhuvaṇ'-antarāĩ de bharasu puṇṇimā-yanda:
ko jāṇaï a-thirā ke-ciraṁ ca tuha erisā riddhī? // Chapp.140
dijjaï dhaṇu maggantāhã; patta-parikkhaha kāĩ?
kiṁ varisantau anka-haru, jōvaï sama-visamāĩ? // Chapp.141
bali-bandhaṇa pekkhēvi naru, patta-parikkha karēha
ōhu bhaṭṭau na ucchuḍaï, jō ni-ssīlaha dēi. // Chapp.142
dejjasu mā sankejjasu; esā su-mahaggha-rayaṇa-nimmaviyā
putta srī mayahara-thāla vva ya vāreṇa sankamaï. // Chapp.143
aṇ-avarayaṁ ciya dento, koi naro hoi viula-riddhillo;
niccaṁ ciya sancanto koi sayā duggao hoi. // Chapp.144
rāy'-aggi-cora-harie lakkha-sahasse kahei para-naṭṭhe
abbhatthio u jamhā, dāliddaṁ dāṇa-gahaṇaṁ ca. // Chapp.145
thevā vi sā gaṇijjaï riddhī jā sayala-loya-sāmannā:
pijjaï vāviĕ jalaṁ, na uṇa samuddassa thevaṁ pi. // Chapp.146
taṁ tattiyaṁ jalaṁ sāyarassa so cceva parama-vitthāro;
ekkaṁ pi palaṁ taṁ natthi jaṁ pivāsā nivārei. // Chapp.147
nā khajjaï nā pijjaï
nā dijjaï vihalāhaṁ
dhattūrā-halu jaïsi
sampai hoi khalāhaṁ. // Chapp.148
cāi-aṇa-kara-parampara-pariyattaṇa-kheya-vasaṇa-parisantā
atthā kivaṇa-ghara-tthā satthāvatthā suvanti vva. // Chapp.149
savvāyareṇa taïyā thutthukkiya-rakkhiyā payatteṇa
kiviṇāṇaṁ jā riddhī para-sāvatthā kumāri vva. // Chapp.150
ōhaya acchaï thutthukiya sampaya kiviṇa-gharēhĩ
thērēṇa vi vivāhīya bhunjēsī avarēhĩ. // Chapp.151
sīsaṁ paliya-palittaṁ thaṇ-antaraṁ viyaliyā muhe dantā,
kampanti do vi hatthā; taha vi maṇaṁ jovvaṇaṁ vahaï. // Chapp.152
dūrōṇāmiya-bhamuhā, pae pae kiṁ visesa-pucchantā
naṭṭhaṁ ca jovvaṇaṁ mahi-yalammi therā gavesanti. // Chapp.153
parihaṇu para-karēhĩ parihijjaï
diyahi diyahi angaṁ parijhijjaï,
bhūmihi kara ṭhāvēvi uṭhijjaï,
taha vi dhammu aṇudiṇu na vi kijjaï. // Chapp.154
siri ekk'-ekkaṁ paliyaḍaṁ, païṭṭhaṁ aggī-bāṇu
nīsaru jovvaṇa-pāhuṇā, jara khaṇḍēsī māṇu. // Chapp.155
bhaviyāṇa taṁ mahāyasa saṁsāra-samudda-nicca-paḍiyāṇaṁ
nijjāmao si sāmiya duggaya-salile nibuḍḍāṇaṁ. // Chapp.156
eaṁ gāhā-kosaṁ jo paḍhaï viyaḍḍha-viraïyaṁ loke
so pāvi viula-riddhī jaṇammi sohaggayaṁ lahaï. // Chapp.157
[(supplément)]
jiṇa-sāsaṇammi bhattī, paṇḍiya-goṭṭhī visiṭṭha-saṁsaggī
muṇivara-dāṇa-pasango na hoi thevehi puṇṇehiṁ. // Chapp.158
na ya bāhaï kamala-vaṇaṁ; appā pīṇaï piei mayarandaṁ
eso bhamara-juvāṇo keṇaï niuṇattaṇa-guṇeṇa. // Chapp.159
lajjijjaï jeṇa jaṇe, maïlijjaï niya-kula-kkamo jeṇa
kaṇṭha-ṭṭhie vi jīe, mā sundara taṁ kuṇijjāsu. // Chapp.160
ārogga-sāriyaṁ māṇusattaṇaṁ sacca-sārio dhammo
vijjā nicchaya-sārā, suhāĩ santosa-sārāiṁ. // Chapp.161
pattammi ya pāhuṇae, kiṁ kāhī duggao turanto vi?
andho maliehiṁ loyaṇehĩ andho cciya varāo. // Chapp.162
jeṇa ṇa kiṁci vi kajjaṁ tassa vi gharam āgayassa je suyaṇā
niccaṁ pahasiya-vayaṇā niya-sīsaṁ āsaṇaṁ denti. // Chapp.163
viṇu dhammiṁ hiya-icchiyaĩ āsā-vahi vaṭṭanti
kaṇḍu kavilu jimu kāurisa para-lālaha ghuṇṭanti. // Chapp.164
